scope: source recovery, not a portable business-validation runtime

requirements_not_satisfied_by_copying_so.detail: Archived programs retain original Windows B/worktree/run paths, interpreter path and source-commit bindings. No path substitution or weakened qualification has been applied.

The original M/S/Host require historical source inventories, commit/adoption records, retirement authorities and full native receipts. Actual Run directories, created/terminal files and stdout/stderr are not included.
The 18-byte proof INI source is included; its original runtime readback result is not. Source bytes do not replace that result.

assemble/refresh programs still reference predecessor source packages, before-images, original PINS/authority metadata and syntax/readback results. Complete authoring replay inputs are not claimed by this archive.

Docker, pinned images, actual source qualification, a new dedicated internal network/volumes, and fresh private preparation are runtime prerequisites. No existing production/shared database may be substituted.

Private environment files, actors, credentials, cookies, uploaded files and data volumes are intentionally absent. Any future authorized normal run must create its own private data; do not reuse or reconstruct old private state.

fresh-b-customer-form-external-source-r3 is an unsealed draft tied to the older source. It still needs a successful matching A and complete current-source bindings; source presence is not UI acceptance.

Parent R1 has the confirmed LOAD-01 component-loading omission. Startup plan/accept and final bindings are unfinished. Original refused/UNBOUND entries remain unchanged; the archived components do not constitute an adopted runtime set.

resumption_rule: Review archived sources and existing 09 plan, finish the current source bindings and missing components, then create a newly qualified normal run. Do not forge historical paths/receipts, bypass guards, restart retired instances or restore stopped scenarios.
